editorial.headline: Rachaad White Gets TD; Jacory Croskey-Merritt Leads Playing Time
editorial.thread_title: [WAS] Rachaad White Gets TD; Jacory Croskey-Merritt Leads Playing Time

evidence.feed_summary: Commanders RB Rachaad White notched the backfield's only TD in Sunday's win over the Seahawks, taking a reception in from 6 yards out in the first quarter. That marked his only target for the game, and White added a mere 35 rushing yards on 8 carries. He left briefly with a shoulder injury but returned. RB Jacory Croskey-Merritt, meanwhile, logged 18 carries and 1 catch (on 1 target), while beating White 39-30 in total snaps and 17-14 in pass routes.
evidence.original_title: Rachaad White Gets TD; Jacory Croskey-Merritt Leads Playing Time

editorial.headline: Jaylen Warren Assumes Bellcow Role Without Rico Dowdle
editorial.thread_title: [PIT] Jaylen Warren Assumes Bellcow Role Without Rico Dowdle

evidence.feed_summary: Steelers RB Jaylen Warren had a full-time role with Rico Dowdle sidelined with a toe injury. Warren handled 56 snaps with the other two active RBs (Travis Homer and Lew Nichols) playing a combined 6 snaps. That led to Warren handling 90.6% of RB touches. Warren had 20 touches going for 176 yards.
